claim: 41 of the campaign's 43 maps end at a pushed switch wearing the exit tile 318 (a type 20/21 switch sending on channel 4). The other two end otherwise: E1M7 when its eight gargoyles (types 206 and 207) are dead (their deaths count through closet switches to the exit), and E3M6 when the player walks into sector 517 (trigger_enter, relayed by a closet switch to channel 4).
evidence: 2026-11-26 recount (knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_exits.py): every sender on channel 4 (kChannelLevelExitNormal, NBlood/source/blood/src/eventq.h:29) in the 43 campaign maps is a switch sprite (types 20-22); 41 maps have one wearing tile 318, all pushed. E1M7: closet switch sprite 109 (tile 0) on rx 106, sent by switch 173 (type 20) and combination switches 174-176 (type 22), which listen to gargoyles 76, 93-95, 180-183. E3M6: closet switch sprite 748 on rx 175, whose only sender is sector 517 (trigger_enter)
use: End a level at a pushed exit switch at the place the level is about; a boss's death or a walked-into sector are the campaign's rarer endings.

checked.how: Recounted with knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_exits.py (the cited consolidation_audit_mid_exits.py imports a module from work/): 41 of 43 maps have a channel-4 sender wearing 318, all type 21 (27) or 20 (14) with trigger_push; every channel-4 sender is a type 20-22 sprite. E1M7: sprite 109 (type 20, tile 0) rx 106; senders on 106 are 173 (type 20 toggle, not a combination) and 174-176 (type 22); all four listen on 109 to gargoyles 76, 183 (207) and 93-95, 180-182 (206). E3M6: sprite 748 rx 175, only sender sector 517 (trigger_enter, trigger_once).
